_description: Shared model registry for all AIXIA-workspace projects. Projects resolve model family → current_version at runtime from this file. Maintained by the bi-weekly model-release crawler (scheduled trigger). See ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md §9.5 for policy.
_bootstrap_note: This is the bootstrap state from 2026-04-20. Entries marked bootstrap_unverified: true are seeded from CLAUDE Code context and should be verified on the first crawler run. Pricing drifts; registry values are authoritative — always re-read at call-time.

claude_opus.notes: UPDATED Oct 5, 2026: claude-opus-5 → claude-opus-5-5 (released September 22, 2026). 🟢 PRICE DECREASE: input $5.00→$4.00/M (20% cut); output $25.00→$20.00/M (20% cut). Cached input: $0.20/M. 1M context window, 128K max output. Anthropic's new leading model with early testers reporting large performance jumps on complex work. Accepts text (including voice dictation) and image inputs. Available on Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI. claude-opus-5 remains available but superseded. PREV (Jul 27, 2026): claude-opus-4-8 → claude-opus-5; SWE-bench Verified 96.0%, SWE-bench Pro 79.2%, FrontierBench v0.1 43.3% at max effort.

deepseek_general.notes: UPDATED Sep 21, 2026: deepseek-v4-flash → deepseek-v4.1-flash (released September 10, 2026). 🟢 PRICE DECREASE: Off-peak rates now $0.15/$0.60 per million tokens (down from $0.22/$0.66 — 32% input reduction, 9% output reduction). Peak rates (01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, Mon–Fri) are 2× off-peak: $0.30/$1.20. Cache hits: $0.003/M off-peak, $0.006/M peak. pricing_per_million_usd reflects off-peak rate. Context window reduced from 1,310,720 → 1,048,576 tokens; max output 384K tokens. NEW: native multimodal visual understanding — accepts text, image input natively. Architecture overhaul: new Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) MoE — 552B total params (~2× V4-Flash's 284B), 8B active on input / 16B active on output. Outperforms flagship V4-Pro on benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1: 90.6, DeepSWE v1.1: 74.2%, GPQA Diamond: 90.9, Codeforces: 3,471, CyberGym: 88.1). ⚠️ IMPORTANT: DeepSeek is temporarily routing deepseek-v4-pro API calls to V4.1-Flash (billed at Flash pricing) until V4.1-Pro releases — see deepseek_reasoning notes. All AIXIA projects should update capabilities assumptions for deepseek_general to include vision/multimodal. Chinese-server jurisdiction — disclose in ToS.

deepseek_reasoning.notes: 🟢 EFFECTIVE PRICE DROP Sep 21, 2026: DeepSeek is routing all deepseek-v4-pro API calls to V4.1-Flash and billing at Flash rates until V4.1-Pro releases. The model string deepseek-v4-pro continues to work; responses are now V4.1-Flash quality (which outperforms V4-Pro on benchmarks). Peak rates: $0.30/$1.20. ⚠️ V4.1-Pro (true successor reasoning model) is in development; expect a future price correction when it launches. ⚠️ REDUNDANCY NOTE: This family was remapped to deepseek-v4-pro on Aug 12, 2026 when deepseek-r1 was found to not exist on the live API. deepseek_v4_pro is a duplicate entry (0 call sites) — retire that one, not this one (owner decision still open). 1M context window, 1.6T total / 49B active params, Thinking+Non-Thinking dual mode. Chinese-server jurisdiction.

gemini_flash.notes: Verified Oct 5, 2026; no version change. UPDATED Sep 21, 2026: gemini-3.7-flash → gemini-3.8-flash (released September 2, 2026). Pricing: $0.75/$3.75/M launch rate. ⚠️ PRICING CLIFF Jan 1, 2027: reverts to ~$1.50/$7.50 — all AIXIA project cost models must update before year-end (87 days from Oct 5). Context: 1,048,576 tokens; output cap: 65,536 tokens. Configurable reasoning/thinking levels (low/medium/high, ON by default). Accepts text, image, video, audio, PDF. Cached input: ~$0.075/M. Gemini Omni Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) also GA September 2026 — video generation model, not tracked separately. ⚠️ GEMINI 4 ARGON announced Sep 30 (limited access, no API ID yet) — see gemini_pro_multimodal notes.

openai_gpt.notes: UPDATED Oct 5, 2026: gpt-6-astra → gpt-6.1-sol (released early October 2026). 🟢 PRICE DROP: $10/$50 → $2/$10 per million tokens (80% reduction on both). GPT-6.1 Sol 'nearly matches' GPT-6 Astra at one-fifth the cost. Context: 1,050,000 tokens (922K input / 128K output). Cached input: $0.10/M. Cache writes: $2.50/M. Long-context surcharge: prompts >272K tokens billed at 2× input, 1.5× output. Knowledge cutoff: April 30, 2026. Available on ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API. GPT-6 Astra ($10/$50) remains available for highest-performance requirements — for fallback_only routing, gpt-6.1-sol is now the preferred choice. PREV (Sep 7, 2026): gpt-5.6-sol → gpt-6-astra at $10/$50 (+100% price hike). Since openai_gpt is default_use: fallback_only with no active AIXIA routing, this price drop is informational — projects may now cost-effectively adopt OpenAI as a fallback.

Output cost ($7.50/M) is 5× mistral_large — only worth it when unified reasoning+coding at long context is required.

mistral_reasoning.notes: Verified Sep 7, 2026; no change. magistral-medium-2506: $2.00/$5.00 per million tokens, 41K context. Budget option: magistral-small-2506 at $0.50/$1.50, 40K context. grok.notes: UPDATED Oct 5, 2026: grok-4.6 → grok-4.7 (released September 21, 2026). Pricing UNCHANGED: $2/$6/M; $4/$12 for prompts ≥200K tokens; cached input: $0.50/M. Same 500K context window. New larger base model vs 4.6; longer RL training run on harder task mix; better at verifying its own work and managing longer context. Knowledge cutoff updated to May 2026. Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: 46 (vs Fable 5.1 at 53). Available on xAI API, Grok app, Cursor, Grok Build, Ramp Router (50% off through Oct 6). Grok 4.8 (2.5T params, C++ stack) and 4.9 announced but no release dates. 🚨 PRIOR BREAKING CHANGES (logged Jul 13, 2026): context window halved 1M→500K vs grok-4.3; output pricing +140%. Any project routing Grok calls >500K tokens must use gemini_pro_multimodal.

routing_defaults.description: Canonical default routing for common task categories. Projects override as needed in their local CLAUDE.md.

privacy_mode_routing.description: When a project/tier enables Privacy Mode, all calls route through Claude only (no DeepSeek, no third-party-jurisdiction routes). Studio-tier Echoform users default to Privacy Mode.
